thought.title: Knowledge travels like a song
thought.excerpt: Knowledge is not an isolated object. It lives, changes, and takes new forms as it moves between people, teams, organizations, and situations.
thought.body: When knowledge becomes a model, it becomes easier to carry, and easier to detach from the situation where it was created.

perspective.title: Cambio, by Formafantasma
perspective.description: A design studio’s long investigation into the timber industry, shown as an exhibition: the material, the supply chains, the people and the open questions, side by side.
perspective.why: It treats research as the work itself, and lets visitors see how understanding was built, not only what was concluded.

investigation.title: Replatforming
investigation.question: What should change, and what should be protected, when the platform underneath a business is replaced?

episode.question: What should never be replatformed?
episode.intro: A conversation with a CTO in industrial technology about what a platform shift quietly removes, and how to notice it in time.
observations: The old system knew things nobody had written down.
The best question to ask before a migration is what people do around the system, not in it.

question: When did a framework last make your organisation weaker?
